title.zh: 修复：旋律步数越界与和声 op 被校验拒绝
title.en: Fixes: a melody that overran its pattern, and a harmony op the schema rejected

highlights.zh: generate_melody bars=4 曾返回 96 步（应为 64）：负长度切片把 32 个幽灵乐句追加到了尾部。
highlights.en: generate_melody with bars=4 returned 96 steps instead of 64: a negative slice length appended 32 ghost phrases.

highlights.zh: set_chord_progression 已加入运行时 schema；此前实现、文档与 suggest_progression 都推荐它，但校验会直接打回。
highlights.en: set_chord_progression is now in the runtime schema; the implementation, the docs and suggest_progression all recommended it while validation rejected it.

highlights.zh: 新增测试：op 类型与运行时 schema 的成员必须一一对应，两者不能再各自漂移。
highlights.en: New test: the op type and the runtime schema must list the same members, so neither can drift alone.
